questions.question: The sum of the ages of Reeta and Geeta is 56 years; after five years the age of Geeta will be five times that of the Reeta. What is the present age ( in years) of the Reeta?
questions.questionHtml: The sum of the ages of Reeta and Geeta is 56 years; after five years the age of Geeta will be five times that of the Reeta. What is the present age ( in years) of the Reeta?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is:

Reeta + Geeta = 56 years…….(i)

Geeta + 5 = 5(Reeta+5)

Geeta – 5Reeta = 20…………..(ii)

From (i) and (ii),

Age of Reeta = 6 years
